subject: DPIA evidence & instrumentation request — onboarding artifacts and archive handoff
messages:
From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@novamed.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@freshbank.com; legal_ops@novamed.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: DPIA evidence & operational artifacts for onboarding

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier — our audit team has asked for a concise package to complete the DPIA and Art. 28/30 checks. To keep things moving on our side, can you confirm you can provide the following by EOD next Wednesday (2028-06-25)?

- Article 30 processing activities extract (exportable CSV) showing processors/subprocessors for the last 12 months
- Sample processing ledger extract (PII redaction is fine) for a typical customer ingestion flow
- Evidence of KMS wrapping + key custody statement (short PDF acceptable)
- Access logs (operator/admin) for the last 30 days with filters for the staging environment. If full logs are not possible, we can accept a sampled extract plus retention policy statement
- SOC 2 report summary or attestation and most recent penetration test high-level findings
- Current subprocessors list and onboarding/decommissioning timeline for any EU-affecting vendors

We attached our onboarding checklist to help map items to Novamed internal reviewers. Our audit lead (cc'd) will coordinate any follow-ups.

Also — please indicate who on your side will own delivery and whether we need a separate signed addendum for artifact transfer.

Appreciate it,

Sarah Lang
Legal Operations | Novamed Health
---
Attachment: Novamed_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence & operational artifacts for onboarding

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa from Privacy (cc) for the Article 30 extract and ledger sample, and Soojin from Product Security for the KMS/logs/SOC items.

Proposed next steps:
1) We will deliver a scoped Article 30 CSV + sample ledger extract by 2028-06-23 for your internal review. The ledger will be redacted by default; tell us which fields you need if you require more context.
2) Soojin will provide a KMS attestation + access-control statement and a 30-day sampled admin-access extract by 2028-06-25. If the audit team needs full raw logs, we can discuss a secure time-limited handover process.
3) Marissa will share our current subprocessors list and a short note on EU data residency controls by 2028-06-22.

About the addendum: we already have a DPA in DocuSign for the account (HubSpot deal HB-4721). If Novamed needs a transfer addendum for evidence delivery, we can route a short exhibit.

Deliverables owner: Diego (coordination), Marissa (privacy artifacts), Soojin (security/artifacts).

Thanks — we’ll mark action items and follow up with links/files as they are ready.

Diego Fernandez
Customer Trust & Privacy | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood_article30_template.pdf (PDF template)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@novamed.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence & operational artifacts for onboarding

Hi Sarah,

Couple of clarifying Qs from Privacy so we scope the extracts correctly:
- Retention boundary: do you need a rolling 12 months of Article 30 history or a point-in-time ledger snapshot? We can provide both but it affects extraction time.
- Ledger sampling: is a 5% sample acceptable for logs with PII redaction, or do you need a larger sample size for the DPIA?
- Redaction policy: we will replace unique identifiers with deterministic tokens; if you need pseudonymisation details (salt/pepper approach) we can provide a short technical note.

Also — can you confirm the authority who will sign off on the evidence receipt (name & title) so we can include a transfer acknowledgement?

For transparency: the sample-ledger-extract.csv will include columns: timestamp, processing_activity, subprocessors, data_category (redacted), and operator_role. If Novamed needs user-level IDs for traceability, we will need a formal NDA addition to allow less-redacted extracts.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Privacy Analyst | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: sample-ledger-extract.csv (CSV stub)
From: Alex Rivera <audits@freshbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence & operational artifacts for onboarding

Diego / Sarah — Alex from FreshBank audit team here (cc'd earlier). Quick responses while we review the checklist: 

- Article 30: a point-in-time export dated 2028-06-01 is fine for our baseline; if you can also provide a rolling activity summary for April–June that would be helpful but not required.
- Ledger sampling: 10% of ingestion events + full operator/admin actions for the 30-day window — that should be sufficient for our risk assessment. Pseudonymisation notes are requested but full user IDs are not necessary.
- Logs: we prefer a secure, time-limited S3 access link to a gzipped export rather than emailing CSVs. If Redwood can provide a signed URL (expire in 7 days) to a staging bucket, we will retrieve and validate there.

Timeline acceptance: 2028-06-22 for subprocessors list, 2028-06-23 Article 30 + sample ledger, 2028-06-25 security artifacts (KMS attestation + 30-day sampled logs). Those dates work for us.

HubSpot note: we referenced your deal HB-4721 in our tracker. If you want a single consolidated delivery, please bundle docs into the Drive folder Diego mentioned and send the signed link.

Thanks — I will wait for the Drive link and the signed transfer acknowledgement.

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Audit Lead | FreshBank (supporting Novamed)
